ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels in central regions and 25% low-intensity black pixels along the periphery and within focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white regions across both lobes. Discrete dark focal spots are present on the upper-left lobe and mid-right lobe. Dark, irregular border pixels define the fluke perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined U-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected across the entire trailing boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels forming a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a prominent dark circular pixel cluster on the lateral-anterior region of the left lobe; additional smaller circular clusters localized near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) intersecting across both lobes, particularly prominent in the mid-sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense linear scarring across the ventral surface; irregular, notch-heavy topography along the trailing edges suggesting historical tissue degradation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular ocellus-like marker on the upper-left lobe anterior margin.
